subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should maintainers accept `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` as the package-build knob for msteams native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix adds package build metadata and changes official installed-plugin startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Accept the narrow CJS build opt-in after the PR's type-check blocker and package-runtime proof are resolved.

options.title: Keep the knob internal-only or redesign it
options.body: Revise the linked PR if `runtimeFormat` should not become a plugin-author-facing package metadata precedent.

options.title: Reject CJS package sidecars for now
options.body: Close or replace the linked PR if maintainers want publishable plugin runtime packages to remain ESM-only for this release train.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Accept the narrow CJS build opt-in after the PR's type-check blocker and package-runtime proof are resolved.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced and recently maintained the package-local npm runtime builder that this issue targets.
